learning.title: Reporting API createdAfter checkpoint must follow successful processing
learning.claim: The YouTube Reporting API recommends advancing the createdAfter cursor only after reports have been successfully processed; a cursor advanced past a failed or unprocessed report can exclude it from later incremental listings, including backfilled reports.
learning.decision: REPORT_CREATED_AFTER_ACK_GATE: Keep createdAfter unchanged until all selected reports in the paginated batch have been downloaded, validated, and durably imported (or explicitly deduplicated). On a partial failure, retain the prior checkpoint and replay idempotently by report ID. For reports with the same job and period, retain the newest createTime as the backfill replacement; never sum old and new versions. Advance only after durable success/read-back, and record the checkpoint with the processed report IDs. Do not infer actual channel ingestion without authorized API evidence.
learning.next_measurement: On the next authorized Reporting API ingestion test, simulate an older report failing after a newer report succeeds, then confirm no cursor advancement, successful replay, report-ID dedup, backfill replacement and durable read-back.
failure_history: Earlier attempt to stage this learning was blocked; no production ingestion or checkpoint read-back is verified.
fallback_history: Keep the previous createdAfter checkpoint and replay pending reports by ID after transient ingestion failures; if Reporting API access is unavailable, keep channel completeness unknown.

research_evidence.dedup: No existing learning covers successful-processing acknowledgment before advancing createdAfter; learn_d1c08b15e1c9cc68 covers backfill replacement only.
research_evidence.limitations: No owned-channel Reporting API authorization or ingestion response checked; this is a verified documented processing rule, not proof of production use.
